text: Hi you are selected as remote data clerk for Northlake Retail. Start tomorrow. Send a photo of your SIN and student permit in this chat so payroll can be opened today.
Congratulations. Deposit this cheque, keep $200 as your mystery-shopper fee, and Interac the rest to our graphics vendor so we can wrap your car.
We can lock a food-service LMIA job in Brantford. You pay 18000 CAD this week for the employer filing. PR path included. No interview needed.
Saw your resume online. Easy product-boost tasks 400 a day. Install our app, then pay 80 USDT to unlock withdrawal.

Maple Desk Ltd (Kitchener) is hiring a junior backend co-op for Winter 2027. Apply on mapledesk.ca/careers. First step is a 30-minute Zoom with the eng manager. We do not ask for SIN or banking until a written offer is signed. hr@mapledesk.ca
From hr@mapledesk.ca: welcome aboard. After you sign the attached offer, PeopleOps will collect your SIN for the Record of Employment and T4, as required. Interview already completed 12 Oct.
Hiring customer support. Must be eligible to work in Canada. Email your resume to the manager. Pay competitive. Remote.

Birch and Parcel can start you Monday as a picker in Cambridge. Before the schedule goes out, pay the $350 training and uniform deposit by e-transfer. They say the deposit comes back after 90 days. Reply in this chat for the payment name.

From IRCC Document Unit <notices@ircc-file-check.com>: your work-permit file is on hold. Reply with your SIN and a photo of the passport bio page, and pay the $200 priority fee by Interac today. This mailbox is the only channel. Do not visit a government office.

You are approved as a payment clerk for Fern Asset Desk. Clients will Interac you about $900. Keep $75, turn the rest into Bitcoin, and send it to the wallet in our next message. No call. Start tonight.
Northlake Retail onboarding is today. Reply with a clear photo of your passport and study permit. There is no phone call. The badge cannot be made without the pictures.
Welcome to the product-boost desk. Your screen shows $640, but the app will not release it. Buy two $100 Steam cards and send the codes in this email. The withdrawal unlocks after the codes arrive.

Lantern Wrap will pay you to drive with an ad on the car. First we courier a cheque for $2,400. Deposit it, keep $400, and e-transfer the rest to the installer. Stay in this Telegram. Nobody will meet you.

Service Canada Hiring Desk <jobs@servicecanada-apply.net> writes: you are selected for a clerk role. Confirm by paying the $150 badge fee and sending your SIN in this thread before 6 pm. There is no interview.

Pinetop Mystery Shops needs secret shoppers across Ontario. We mail a cheque. You buy the items, keep a small fee, and wire what is left to the survey company. No resume and no meeting. Text this posting to start.
The Brantford hotel job is yours as of this message. Send $180 for the uniform kit in this WhatsApp chat today, or we give the shift away. You start tomorrow morning. We will not do a call.

You got the Service Canada call-centre seat. Text a photo of your SIN and pay the $90 headset deposit with an Amazon gift card. The training link arrives after the card code. Do not phone the public Service Canada number.
A Guelph warehouse LMIA is already approved and we can put your name on it. You pay 22000 CAD this week. That price is the job offer plus a PR path. There is no resume review and no interview.

Maple Permit Partners can sell a food-service job offer in London, Ontario. The price is 15000 CAD, paid by you, not by the restaurant. Work-permit papers are included. They say only a few seats are left this month.
Truck-helper filing in Windsor is ready. You pay the LMIA fee yourself, 9000 dollars, and the offer letter goes out the same day. They call it guaranteed. Reply if you want the account name.
Guaranteed work permit for a Mississauga bakery. Buy the LMIA job for 20000 CAD. The interview is skipped. A PR package costs extra if you want it later.
An Oakville nanny LMIA is for sale. The household will not pay the fee. You pay 12000 CAD to our desk and we send the offer. Ask this email for the name on the transfer.
You are hired for night audit at Huron Night Desk. Do not email anyone. Stay on this Telegram. There will not be a phone call. The site address comes tomorrow.
Roster desk: you are through for the weekend crew. Send a photo of your SIN on this WhatsApp now. We are not using a company email for this.
Saw your resume. The merchandiser job needs a $60 prepaid card for the scanner deposit before Friday. Text the card code to this number.
We found your profile and reached out. Remote product listing, no experience, $45 an hour, anywhere in Canada. Talk only on Telegram. Do not send a resume.
The Shopify Careers team is writing from shopify.people.desk@gmail.com because the main inbox is migrating. Reply to this Gmail and we will book you. Do not write to a shopify.com address today.
Your co-op seat at the Cambridge plant is confirmed in this chat. Pay the $220 shoe-and-uniform fee here today or the seat is released.
Start tomorrow. There is no interview. Text a photo of your passport and study permit to this number so a badge can be printed.
I can only use Telegram. The other message was just to find you. Tell me your city and the job details will come in this chat. No forms yet.
You were picked from a resume list for daily product-boost tasks. Install the task app and pay 60 USDT as a gas fee. They call the fee refundable. Payouts start after the transfer.

Harbour and Pine Studio in Guelph is hiring a junior graphic-design co-op for May 2027. Send a portfolio to jobs@harbourpine.ca. The first meeting is half an hour on site with the studio lead. The role is posted at harbourpine.ca/careers. There is no fee to apply.

Ridgeline Robotics in Waterloo is hiring a backend intern. Apply at ridgelinerobotics.ca/jobs. You meet the engineering manager on Zoom for 30 minutes, then an afternoon on site if that goes well. Write to careers@ridgelinerobotics.ca.

Kinlock Foods in Brantford has a production co-op for the fall term. The posting is on kinlockfoods.ca/careers. Interviews are in the plant with the shift supervisor. Resumes go to hr@kinlockfoods.ca. Pay is discussed in that interview.

From hr@sablefreight.ca. Sable Freight is hiring a part-time support clerk in Hamilton. Read sablefreight.ca/careers, then book a phone screen with the support lead. A paid trial shift on site comes after that call. Nothing is due with your application.

Elm Court Hotels in London, Ontario is hiring a front-desk co-op. Details are at elmcourt.ca/careers. The interview is in the hotel lobby with the front-office manager. Use the careers form or hr@elmcourt.ca.

Quill and Oak Books in Kitchener needs a Saturday bookseller. Apply at quillandoak.ca/jobs. The owner interviews in the shop. The store does not use chat apps for hiring. Questions go to jobs@quillandoak.ca.
Fairview Components in Cambridge is hiring a quality co-op. The ad is on fairviewcomponents.ca/careers. The first meeting is a Zoom with the quality lead. Send resumes to hr@fairviewcomponents.ca.

Westwind Solar in Guelph is hiring a junior analyst. The posting is westwindsolar.ca/careers. The panel is a video call with two engineers. Write to careers@westwindsolar.ca. Do not attach identity documents to the application.

Lakeshore Analytics in Mississauga is hiring a data co-op for summer 2027. Apply at lakeshoreanalytics.ca/careers. You will have a 45-minute video call with the hiring manager. Contact jobs@lakeshoreanalytics.ca.
Office assistant wanted. Must be eligible to work in Canada. Send a resume to the Gmail address on the flyer. Hours vary. The shop name is not on the flyer.

Lumen Draft is a two-person studio hiring a part-time social poster at $18 an hour. Send a resume to lumendraft.jobs@gmail.com. If it fits, we do a Google Meet. No payment and no documents at this step.
Remote data entry is open to anyone in Canada. No experience needed. $42 an hour. Reply with your city. No app to install in this message.
New roles drop in this Telegram every morning. DM the admin to be considered. The posts do not name a company. No fee is mentioned.
Seeking a dishwasher. Must live in Brantford. Evening shifts. Ask for the manager. No company name and no website on the note.
A Waterloo startup is hiring a general helper. Message on WhatsApp or by email, either is fine. Pay will be discussed. The company name was cut off the bottom of the poster.
Thanks for stopping at the campus booth. Send a resume and a course list to the address on the card. Payroll details come later, after an interview. This note does not ask for a SIN.

From hr@cedarlanelogistics.ca. Welcome. You signed the offer on 2 Oct. PeopleOps will collect your SIN for the T4 and the Record of Employment in the payroll portal, not in chat. Your first day is 20 Oct at the Kitchener yard. The interview already happened.

From payroll@sablefreight.ca. Payday is the last Friday of the month. Wages are sent by Interac e-Transfer from this address. This is your salary. Do not forward it to anyone. Questions go to payroll@sablefreight.ca.

Kinlock Foods is hiring a line cook in Brantford. The company uses the LMIA program and Kinlock pays the government fee. Applicants pay nothing. Apply at kinlockfoods.ca/careers. The interview is on site with the kitchen manager. Write to hr@kinlockfoods.ca.
